title: Neptune's supersonic winds
hook: Neptune has winds faster than the speed of sound on Earth.
explanation: Voyager watched clouds streak around the planet. Neptune's winds can reach more than twelve hundred miles per hour.
shots: Open on a labeled illustration of Neptune as a bright cloud band sweeps across.
Follow the cloud features with a small motion trace to show how fast they travel.
Pull back to Neptune and hold the wind-speed comparison for the payoff.
